blind.description: A stone pedestal or pillar topped with a large carved spider sculpture. The pillar has a stepped rectangular base and sides detailed with stylized spiderweb relief carvings. Perched atop the pillar is a rotund spider with stout curled legs gripping the plinth edge, multiple golden cluster eyes, and a prominent yellow longitudinal stripe extending down its abdomen and cephalothorax. Surfaces are solid, stylized, and hand-painted stone texture.
blind.from_above: From directly above, it appears as a bulbous, oval grey spider abdomen and head bisected by a bright yellow stripe, flanked symmetrically by four thick legs on each side, largely obscuring the square pillar beneath.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 1.1 times the height of the figure (about 6.5 feet tall) and about 2 to 2.5 feet wide.
